paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption: The character distribution in RoleplayPref consists of 3 primary categories and 13 subcategories.

annotations.annotation: Die Abbildung ist ein Kreis Diagramm und stellt eine Kategorisierung verschiedener Charaktertypen in drei Hauptgruppen dar: Virtuelle Charaktere, Benutzerdefinierte Charaktere und Reale Charaktere. Es umfasst insgesamt 16 Segmente. Der Kreis ist unterteilt in einen inneren Kreis und einen äußeren. Der innere Kreis besteht aus dem blauen Segment "Virtuelle Charaktere", dem grünen "Benutzerdefinierte Charaktere" und dem roten "Reale Charaktere". Der äußere Kreis ist jeweils in den jeweiligen Farben heller schraffiert. Der virtuelle Charakter Bereich ist im äußeren Kreis unterteilt in 5 Segmente: "Comic Charaktere", "Filmcharaktere", "Fernsehcharaktere", "Romancharaktere" und "Spielcharaktere". Der reale Charakter Bereich in 7 Segmente: "Influencer", "Schauspieler", "Musiker", "Schriftsteller", "Sportler", "Künstler" und "Wissenschaftler" und der benutzerdefinierte Bereich in ein Segment das nicht beschriftet ist.

The pie chart represents a categorization of different types of characters into three main groups: "Virtual Characters"(blue), "Custom Characters"(red), and "Real Characters"(green). These three groups form the inner circle of the chart and are further divided into subgroups in the outer slice of each group. The central blue segment, labeled "Virtual Characters," occupies about 3/4th of the chart and further divides into segments in the outer circle like "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters," each shaded in light blue. "Custom Characters" is shown in a red slice, occupying a smaller portion adjacent to the "Virtual Characters", but doesn't have any labeled sub groups in outer circle. "Real Characters" is depicted in green, with further subdivisions such as "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers" all in shades of light green. The chart doesn't include a legend and percentage labels inside the slices to provide exact proportions. There is no visual emphasis such as exploding or offsetting of any slice. The segments within each main category appear to be presented in the same order, without any specific visual ordering based on size.

Фигурата е кръгова диаграма и представлява категоризация на различни типове герои в три основни групи: виртуални герои, персонализирани герои и реални герои. Състои се от общо 16 сегмента. Кръгът е разделен на вътрешен кръг и външен кръг. Вътрешният кръг се състои от синия сегмент „Виртуални герои“, зеления сегмент „Персонализирани герои“ и червения сегмент „Реални герои“. Външният кръг е щрихован в съответните цветове в по-светъл нюанс. Зоната за виртуални герои е разделена на 5 сегмента във външния кръг: „Герои от комикси“, „Герои от филми“, „Герои от телевизия“, „Герои от романи“ и „Герои от игри“. Зоната на истинския герой е разделена на 7 сегмента: „Влиятелен човек“, „Актьор“, „Музикант“, „Писател“, „Спортист“, „Художник“ и „Учен“, а персонализираната зона е разделена на немаркиран сегмент.

The pie chart illustrates three different characters. The inner circle of the pie chart is divided into three segments of different characters : Virtual Characters represented in blue, Custom Characters represented in red, and Real Characters in green. These three segments are further divided into outer slices, shaded in lighter color. Virtual character segment is further subdivided into “Comic characters”, “Movie Characters”, “Teleplay Characters”, ”Novel Characters” and ”Game Characters”. Custom characters has one unlabeled slice. The real characters segment contains seven slices: ”Scientists”, ”Artists”, ”Athletes”, ”Writers”, ”Musicians”, Actors” and ”Influencers”.

The pie chart illustrates the distribution of characters in RoleplayPref. It shows that characters are grouped into three main categories: "Virtual Characters", "Custom Characters", and "Real Characters", which are represented in blue, red and green colors respectively. The "Virtual Characters" category is the largest at about 270 degrees, and is subdivided into "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters" and "Game Characters" segments, all shaded with a lighter shade of blue. "Real Characters" is further broken into "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors" and "Influencers" subdivisions, all colored in a lighter shade of green. The "Real Characters" main category has no subcategories.
